## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a CI test failure where the `BrowserSimulation.test.tsx` test couldn't render form fields when creating kitchen_sink records. The root cause was that the kitchen_sink object was defined in the configuration but was missing from any app's navigation array, preventing the App component from finding the object definition via URL path matching.

**Changes:**
- Added kitchen_sink object navigation entry to the Analytics app's navigation array
